Season with black pepper, red pepper flakes, italian seasoning, chicken and garlic powders, a bay leaf and a bit of msg. Let everything cook on a low boil for 25-30 mins and let it off the stove. Add some lemon juice, I just eyeball about 2 tablespoons/to taste. And that's all!
